description.text: This program is divided into preliminary, intermediate and advanced levels, with each level further divided into 3 sub-levels. The curriculum includes comprehensive, listening, speaking and reading courses. Students can improve their Chinese communication skills through trainings of listening, speaking, reading and writing.

duration.text: The Winter Short-Term Chinese Language Class at University of International Business and Economics is a 0 N/A long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1375 USD/per semester ￥ 9900 CNY/per semester

materials.text: (Application materials must be prepared in either Chinese or English and will not be returned to candidates no matter they are accepted or not.) UIBE application form (Apply online only) A copy of highest diploma and transcripts A copy of guarantor's passport or ID Applicants under 18 years old need to submit notarized guardianship certificate. A copy of passport or other identification Two recent passport photos, white background, frontal view, no hat

requirements.text: High school diploma, good health. Applicants under 18 years old need to submit notarized guardianship certificate upon the approval of UIBE (For detailed information, please refer to Admissions Office).
